places.name: Grand Place Mons
places.ai_summary: Grand Place Mons is the central square of the city, surrounded by historic buildings, cafes, and restaurants. It is a vibrant hub for social and cultural activities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at one of the cafes while soaking in the ambiance.

attribution.title: 4th Bn Royal Fusiliers 22 August 1914
attribution.author: Ich
attribution.description: "A" Company of the 4th Battalion, Royal Fusiliers (9th Brigade, 3rd Division) on 22 August, 1914, resting in the square at Mons, Belgium, the day before the Battle of Mons. Minutes after this photo was taken the company moved into position at Nimy on the bank of the Mons-Condé Canal.

places.name: Mons Belfry (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: The Mons Belfry is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the only Baroque-style belfry in Belgium. It offers panoramic views of the city and houses a museum detailing its history.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during holidays.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for stunning views of Mons.

places.name: Collegiate Church of Sainte-Waudru
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of Gothic architecture, this collegiate church is dedicated to Saint Waudru, the patron saint of Mons. It features beautiful stained glass windows and an impressive organ.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Check for mass times as the church may be closed to tourists during services.

places.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon for the best light through the stained glass.
places.place_tip: Attend a concert if possible, as the acoustics are remarkable.

places.name: Mons Memorial Museum
places.ai_summary: This museum offers a poignant look at the impact of war on the city of Mons and its people. It includes exhibits on World War I and II, as well as temporary exhibitions on related topics.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Take your time with the audio guides; they provide in-depth information.

places.name: BAM – Beaux-Arts Mons Museum
places.ai_summary: The BAM is a major cultural institution in Mons, hosting a vast collection of fine arts, including paintings, sculptures, and decorative arts, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Check for special late openings.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the temporary exhibitions, which are often very interesting.

places.name: Maison Van Gogh (Cuesmes)
places.ai_summary: This is the house where Vincent van Gogh lived and worked for a time. It is now a museum dedicated to his life and work, with a focus on his time in Belgium.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring and summer for the garden.
places.place_tip: Visit the garden, which is designed as a 19th-century artist's garden.

attribution.title: Cuesmes Mu1aJPG
attribution.author: Jean-Pol GRANDMONT
attribution.description: Cuesmes Belgium, the Van Gogh house.

places.name: Pass – Scientific Adventure Park
places.ai_summary: A unique park that combines science, technology, and adventure. It features interactive exhibits, a planetarium, and outdoor activities.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Check the schedule for planetarium shows.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the outdoor activities.
places.address: Rue de la Science 14, 7000 Mons, Belgium

places.name: Doudou Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the Doudou, the famous local teddy bear. It showcases the history of the Doudou and its creator, as well as various teddy bear exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Great for children and teddy bear enthusiasts.
places.address: Rue de la Digue 17, 7000 Mons, Belgium

places.name: Waux-Hall Park
places.ai_summary: A beautiful public park in Mons, perfect for a leisurely stroll, a picnic, or enjoying the outdoors. It features walking paths, gardens, and a pond.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring and summer for the gardens in bloom.
places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy it by the pond.

places.name: Van Gogh’s Route Walking Trail
places.ai_summary: A walking trail that follows in the footsteps of Vincent van Gogh in Mons. It includes several key locations related to the artist's life in the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best walked in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Download the audio guide for detailed information about each location.
places.address: Starts at Grand Place, 7000 Mons, Belgium

places.name: Havré Castle Ruins
places.ai_summary: The ruins of a medieval castle located in the city park of Mons. It offers a glimpse into the city's medieval past and beautiful views from the remaining structures.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding park area as well.

places.name: Old Slaughterhouse Art Center
places.ai_summary: A contemporary art center located in a former slaughterhouse. It hosts temporary exhibitions of modern art, as well as cultural events and workshops.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Check the schedule for exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Visit the café for a break and to enjoy the view of the art installations.
places.address: Rue de la Slaughterhouse 13, 7000 Mons, Belgium

places.name: Saint-Calixte Chapel
places.ai_summary: A small, historic chapel located in the heart of Mons. It is known for its beautiful baroque architecture and serene interior.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Check for mass times.

places.best_time_to_visit: During the day to appreciate the architecture.
places.place_tip: Light a candle and enjoy a moment of peace.

places.name: Jardin du Mayeur
places.ai_summary: A charming public garden in Mons, featuring a variety of plants, flowers, and trees. It is a peaceful place to relax and enjoy nature.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring for the flowers, autumn for the foliage.
places.place_tip: Bring a book and enjoy the tranquility.

attribution.author: Giovanni Battista Piranesi
attribution.description: "View of the Palazzo Mancini", Rome (Italy), the seat of the French Academy since 1725

places.name: Natural History Museum of Mons
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the natural history of the Mons region, including its geology, flora, and fauna. It also features exhibits on paleontology and archaeology.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Check for special exhibits and events.
places.address: Rue de la Science 14, 7000 Mons, Belgium

places.name: Saint Symphorien Military Cemetery
places.ai_summary: A military cemetery dedicated to the soldiers who fought in the World Wars. It is a place of remembrance and reflection, with well-maintained graves and memorials.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Take a moment to reflect at the memorials.

places.name: Museum François Duesberg
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the works of François Duesberg, a Belgian painter known for his landscapes and genre scenes. The museum houses a large collection of his works.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Look for temporary exhibitions featuring other artists.
places.address: Rue de la Réserve 2, 7000 Mons, Belgium

places.name: Place Nervienne Market
places.ai_summary: A lively market held in the Place Nervienne, offering a variety of local products, including fresh produce, meats, cheeses, and crafts. It's a great place to experience the local culture.

opening_hours.notes: Open Tuesday to Saturday. Closed on Sundays and Mondays.

places.best_time_to_visit: Morning, when the market is in full swing.
places.place_tip: Try the local cheeses and meats.

places.name: Artothèque Museum Depot
places.ai_summary: A unique museum space that serves as a depot for the city's art collection. It offers a behind-the-scenes look at how art is stored and preserved, and occasionally hosts exhibitions.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and Sundays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.best_time_to_visit: During the week for a quieter visit.
places.place_tip: Check for special events or exhibitions.
places.address: Rue de la Réserve 2, 7000 Mons, Belgium

places.name: City Hall Gardens
places.ai_summary: The gardens surrounding the City Hall of Mons, featuring beautiful landscaping, sculptures, and fountains. It's a pleasant place for a walk or to relax.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring and summer for the flowers and greenery.
places.place_tip: Take a moment to relax by the fountains.
